topics.title: Howard Reacts To Douglas Kiker’s Death
topics.summary: During a radio broadcast, Howard Stern discusses his reaction to the death of Douglas Kiker, expressing disbelief and making crude comments about the deceased's appearance and life choices while suggesting an unusual method for ensuring Kiker continues to be tormented after death. The segment includes interruptions from other hosts discussing public opinion.

topics.title: Elvis Special Prank Call with Captain Janks
topics.summary: A caller named Captain Janks describes calling into a live Bill Bixby television special about Elvis Presley being alive and in witness protection. Janks recounts the show's theory that Elvis worked undercover for the FBI in "Operation Fountain Pen" and discusses his prank call experience.

topics.title: Captain Janks Phone Prank Caller Profile
topics.summary: Discussion of Captain Janks, a prolific prank caller who calls radio and television shows. Hosts describe his bootleg tape compilation of approximately 50,000 calls to various personalities, including an incident where he reached Steve Martin at Larry King's green room, and an unauthorized pizza delivery to Roseanne Barr using the host's name.

topics.summary: A comedy sketch featuring a parody game show called "Black Jeopardy" with categories including bloodlines, black crime, spelling, black foods, and black television. Contestants compete for prizes while hosts and guests make jokes throughout the game.
